notes: Non-blocking remarks. (1) README, Assumptions: the paraphrase of Compiler.Faithful ('provided the launch is valid and the model's launch well behaved') leaves out the rule's premise debug = false and its scope; both are stated elsewhere (Proof: hdebug; Conditions: the host within the scope), so this is wording only. (2) The module binds x and y at lines 86-87 (host lines), the same names as the kernel's locals of lines 50-51. The kernel assigns them before its only read (line 52), so by SEMANTICS.md (The supported subset, Names: the names its statements assign) the launch reads its own loads, not the host's tensors; the host lines bind nothing the launch reads, and lines 23-24 (kernel lines) bind the only module-level names it reads (triton, tl). (3) Round-1 F1 was raised by r-vecadd and is closed; I have nothing to release or re-raise. (4) work/Names.lean and work/Instances.lean print the model, launch, conditions, Post and Assumptions with full names and explicit instances: every operation is TVA.* (tl.program_id, tl.arange, tl.load, tl.add, tl.store, Tensor.ltS, Tensor.instHAddIntV, instHAddPtrTensorIntV, IntV.instMul, Prog.instMonad) or core Nat arithmetic (Nat.instDiv, instSubNat, instAddNat) in the grid formula; main, consistent and satisfiable depend only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. work/Checks.lean checks that IntV.ofNat B is IntV.ofInt B (the map note of line 44), that the model's body is Block.offs/Block.mask of the program id by rfl, and the grid and the last offset at the extremes of Inst.ok (n = 2^31 - 1 with BLOCK_SIZE = 1 and 2^20) and at the host's sizes.
